name: aura
description: Aura — an AI Relationship Platform (voice-first, memory, emotional intelligence).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @aura/api && npm run build --workspace @aura/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @aura/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @aura/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
